name: gravitykit-mcp
description: Build, edit, and query your Gravity Forms with Claude.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the Gravity Forms on your WordPress site: create and edit forms, add and rearrange fields, read and update entries, manage add-on feeds, and answer questions about your submissions in plain language. When GravityKit Foundation is active on the site, tools for GravityKit products such as GravityView are added automatically.

Setup asks for three things: your site address, your WordPress username, and a WordPress application password (in WordPress, go to Users > Profile > Application Passwords, add one named "Claude", and copy it including the spaces). Deleting forms and entries stays off unless you turn it on during setup.

app_password.title: Application password
app_password.description: Users > Profile > Application Passwords, spaces and all

allow_delete.title: Allow Claude to delete and overwrite your data
allow_delete.description: Covers deleting forms, entries and feeds, deleting Views, and importing a migration bundle over this site's data. Deletions move items to the Trash, where you can restore them; a bundle import does not.

allow_destructive.title: Allow only some destructive tools (optional)
allow_destructive.description: Comma-separated. Use a product prefix (gmig for migrations, gv for Views, gf for Gravity Forms), an exact tool name, or "all". Leave empty to use the checkbox above, which permits everything.
